title: LagRemover
description: Lightweight Paper plugin to optimize server performance by cleaning entities and monitoring TPS.
body:
# LagRemover

LagRemover is a lightweight optimization plugin for Paper servers.

It helps reduce lag by automatically cleaning unnecessary entities and monitoring your server's TPS.

## Features

- Automatic entity cleanup
- Manual cleanup command
- TPS monitoring
- LagShield system
- Entity limiter
- Modular system
- English & French support
- OP setup wizard
- Lightweight and easy to configure

## Commands

- `/lagremover`
- `/lagremover help`
- `/lagremover clear`
- `/lagremover tps`
- `/lagremover modules`
- `/lagremover module <module> <on|off>`
- `/lagremover language <fr|en>`
- `/lagremover reload`
- `/lagremover version`

## Current Modules

- ItemsCleaner
- EntityLimiter
- LagShield

More optimization modules are planned in future updates.
